priority_policy_rules_effect_chk.name: priority_policy_rules_effect_chk
priority_policy_rules_effect_chk.value:
("priority_policy_rules"."kind" NOT IN ('boost', 'penalty') OR "priority_policy_rules"."effect_value" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("priority_policy_rules"."kind" <> 'sla' OR "priority_policy_rules"."sla_hours" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("priority_policy_rules"."kind" NOT IN ('lane_floor', 'lane_cap') OR "priority_policy_rules"."effect_lane" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("priority_policy_rules"."kind" <> 'never_above' OR "priority_policy_rules"."other_condition" IS NOT NULL)

voice_profiles_scales_chk.name: voice_profiles_scales_chk
voice_profiles_scales_chk.value: "voice_profiles"."formality" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "voice_profiles"."verbosity" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "voice_profiles"."emoji_use" BETWEEN 0 AND 3

generated.as: CASE WHEN covered_from IS NOT NULL AND covered_to IS NOT NULL THEN tstzrange(covered_from, covered_to, '[)') END

scan_ledger_entries_range_chk.name: scan_ledger_entries_range_chk
scan_ledger_entries_range_chk.value: "scan_ledger_entries"."covered_from" IS NULL OR "scan_ledger_entries"."covered_to" IS NULL OR "scan_ledger_entries"."covered_to" >= "scan_ledger_entries"."covered_from"

work_items_new_info_idx.name: work_items_new_info_idx
work_items_new_info_idx.where: "work_items"."last_new_info_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("work_items"."seen_by_user_at" IS NULL OR "work_items"."last_new_info_at" > "work_items"."seen_by_user_at")

work_items_snooze_chk.name: work_items_snooze_chk
work_items_snooze_chk.value: "work_items"."status" <> 'snoozed' OR ("work_items"."snoozed_until" IS NOT NULL AND "work_items"."snoozed_from_status" IS NOT NULL AND "work_items"."snoozed_from_status" NOT IN ('snoozed', 'done', 'dismissed', 'merged'))

work_items_done_chk.name: work_items_done_chk
work_items_done_chk.value: ("work_items"."status" = 'done') = ("work_items"."done_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_items"."done_by" IS NOT NULL)

work_items_no_self_ref_chk.name: work_items_no_self_ref_chk
work_items_no_self_ref_chk.value: "work_items"."parent_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "work_items"."id" AND "work_items"."merged_into_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "work_items"."id"

work_items_resolution_chk.name: work_items_resolution_chk
work_items_resolution_chk.value: ("work_items"."resolution" IS NULL OR "work_items"."status" IN ('done', 'dismissed', 'merged')) AND "work_items"."resolution_work_item_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "work_items"."id"

work_items_effort_chk.name: work_items_effort_chk
work_items_effort_chk.value: ("work_items"."effort_minutes" IS NULL OR "work_items"."effort_minutes" >= 0) AND ("work_items"."lead_time_minutes" IS NULL OR "work_items"."effort_minutes" IS NULL OR "work_items"."lead_time_minutes" >= "work_items"."effort_minutes")

drafts_approval_chk.name: drafts_approval_chk
drafts_approval_chk.value: "drafts"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'scheduled', 'sending', 'unconfirmed', 'sent', 'staged', 'handed_off', 'verified', 'verify_failed') OR ("drafts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "drafts"."approval_method" IS NOT NULL AND "drafts"."approved_content_hash" = "drafts"."content_hash")

drafts_autonomy_chk.name: drafts_autonomy_chk
drafts_autonomy_chk.value: "drafts"."approval_method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'autonomy_policy' OR "drafts"."autonomy_policy_id" IS NOT NULL

activity_entries_approval_chk.name: activity_entries_approval_chk
activity_entries_approval_chk.value: "activity_entries"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'synced_to_canvas') OR "activity_entries"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL

activity_entries_ready_chk.name: activity_entries_ready_chk
activity_entries_ready_chk.value: "activity_entries"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'synced_to_canvas') OR "activity_entries"."operation" <> 'create' OR "activity_entries"."se_task_type_id" IS NOT NULL

jobs_running_lease_chk.name: jobs_running_lease_chk
jobs_running_lease_chk.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

change_sets_undo_chk.name: change_sets_undo_chk
change_sets_undo_chk.value: "change_sets"."kind" NOT IN ('undo', 'redo') OR "change_sets"."undo_of_change_set_id" IS NOT NULL

watch_subscriptions_scope_chk.name: watch_subscriptions_scope_chk
watch_subscriptions_scope_chk.value:
num_nonnulls("watch_subscriptions"."channel_id", "watch_subscriptions"."opportunity_id", "watch_subscriptions"."account_id", "watch_subscriptions"."person_id", "watch_subscriptions"."initiative_id", "watch_subscriptions"."search_query") = 1
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'channel' OR "watch_subscriptions"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'opportunity' OR "watch_subscriptions"."opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'account' OR "watch_subscriptions"."account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'person' OR "watch_subscriptions"."person_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'initiative' OR "watch_subscriptions"."initiative_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("watch_subscriptions"."scope_kind" <> 'search_query' OR "watch_subscriptions"."search_query" IS NOT NULL)
